notes.title: New Update with more content!
notes.notes:
What's new:

 New Enemy Added (Skat)
 New Pet Added (Friendly Skat)
 New Items Added (Skat Skull, Friendly Skat Skull)
 New Crafts Added (Friendly Skat Skull, Skat)
 Particules Added on S-Lava Jumper Minigame
 Preview of the 3rd Zone (Kingdom)

notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes:
What's new:

 New Languages (French & Portuguese)
 Able to change the Game's Language in the Settings
 Gems Added
 Crafting System
 Dash Ability
 Double Jump Ability Added
 Able to skip the Tutorial Quests
 Able to Cancel a Quest
 Settings Added (in game)
 Able to stop the moving bg in the Settings (better perform.)
 New elements in the Main Menu
 New UI in the Arcade Machine
 New Mini Game in the Arcade Machine (S-Lava Jumper)


Issues fixed:

 Save & Load system wasn't Saving or Loading correctly
